name: Can I repair my roof myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair my roof myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor repairs might seem simple, roof work can be dangerous and complex. Walking on a roof carries significant fall risks, and improper repairs can lead to further damage, void warranties, or create new leaks. Professional roofers have the training, safety equipment, and expertise to correctly diagnose problems and perform durable repairs that comply with local building codes. It's generally recommended to hire a professional for safety and quality assurance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional for roof repair is recommended due to safety risks, the complexity of the work, and the need for correct diagnosis and durable repairs.
